players.label: First claim
players.reason: Jonah Coleman over RJ Harvey: Coleman led Denver’s RB snaps on his return. This upgrades the same backfield exposure without sacrificing a starting RB.

players.label: Fallback claim
players.reason: Omar Cooper Jr. is the WR upside alternative if Coleman is unavailable. Use the same Harvey drop so only one claim fills that spot.

players.label: Watch health
players.reason: Jaylen Waddle is a longer-term alternative; check his chest injury before using a claim.

players.label: Watch health
players.reason: Ladd McConkey is another upside alternative, subject to concussion clearance.

rosterMove: Keep Steelers and Shrader. Vikings are included in two pending trade offers; do not drop them without reconsidering those offers. Available targets currently show waivers, with no confirmed clearing time.
